name: SMART-RECON
aliases: Synchronized multiartifact reduction with tomographic reconstruction
definition: An iterative reconstruction method for time-resolved CT that eliminates limited-view artifacts and mitigates temporal-average artifacts by jointly reconstructing all image frames using a nuclear norm regularizer on a spatial-temporal image matrix.
summary: SMART-RECON is an iterative time-resolved CT method that eliminates limited-view artifacts by jointly reconstructing frames using a nuclear norm regularizer on spatiotemporal data.
